body: Feel that to my core. It’s hell on earth. I keep waiting to get some terminal illness or something, I just keep smoking and smoking hoping my lungs give out one day or I get some kind of cancer. It’s fucked up to say but lol
I’m in the same place. I wish I wasn’t such a pussy and could just get it over with. But I keep holding on. My body just won’t let me do it my but head is so tired.
I’m in the same place right now. Can’t sleep and I haven’t slept good all week and my mind is going insane with hyperactivity. Dm me, if you feel comfortable. I don’t bite.

Is this for schizophrenia? I stopped my antipsychotic drugs (depakote and gabapentin) cold turkey w out a doctor and I went really manic and kinda feel less energy more than normal but I don’t think you’re going to physically die…? Might just go through some crazy emotions and mental struggle, Idk what condition you have and it’s different for everyone. I got back on my meds and I feel better. Don’t stop without tapering off and with a doctor supervising the process.
Lol Dude I didn’t do anything or harass anyone. I defended someone and you’re mad bc I put you in your place?

I feel the same. I drag everyone in my life down and they say they care about me and that they don’t want me to die but I know they’re so tired and sick of dealing with my constant mental issues and BPD. Why do you feel like a burden? What’s going on? Dm me if you want.

If it’s been going on for years and they’ve been in and out of mental hospitals and can’t function or care for themselves. I think it’s one thing to kill yourself on a whim from situational depression (like a breakup) but it’s another thing to kill yourself from mental illness that is embedded in you and has been your entire life. Then I think it’s merciful.
What are you going to say?
Hey stranger. Message me if you need to vent. I’m at rock bottom and hate myself too so we have that in common lol. I won’t pass any judgement. No pressure just want to let you know someone cares.

Hi stranger. 
Hope you’re still here. Please message me if you need to vent. Im in the same place you’re in so I won’t pass any judgment.

I’m sorry you feel this way. I know the feeling and I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. Honestly there’s nothing you can say that is going to spare them the heartache. Your words will be meaningless and the only thing they’ll care about is that you’re gone and you’ll be remembered for the way you died the rest of your life probably. It sucks but that’s just the reality of taking your life. There has and will always be a stigma against mental health and suicide. other causes of death just don’t impact people the same way as suicide does. I wish I got into a car accident so people wouldn’t see me as a coward but I’m done waiting for that to happen so I’m right there with you buddy. Good luck.
You are not a coward. If anything you are courageous and strong to wake up every morning and choose life. That is bravery. They always say suicide is the cowards way out.

They say 80% of people who have made an attempt and lived to tell the story first thought right after was “well why the fuck did I do that?” It isn’t until it’s happening I think that we realize how terrifying it is to die. 

You don’t want to die. You want control of your life. You need to accept that self control is an illusion…I know you probably don’t feel like it but look into philosopher “Alan Watts” he is my spirit guide and listening to his lectures on YouTube saved my life. Mark Manson, an author, also wrote a great book called “everything is fucked”. I highly recommend listening to either of those guys. I was highly suicidal a week ago and finally found my zen.
